item.title: [83] 2027 Tree Pruning Services
item.description:
Agency: Ada County Highway District | Stage: OPEN_BID | Type: RFP | Due: 2026-12-02 | Location: Ada County, Idaho
The RFP seeks competitive proposals from qualified Firms to provide clearance pruning of approximately 20,000 trees within the public right-of-way and/or private property trees and shrubs that overhang onto public right-of-way on selected streets . Completion of the pruning must be completed by June 30, 2027. ACHD shall be entitled to "Liquidated Damages" of $250.00 for each calendar day of delay in the completion of the work.
